**Behavior:** The owl began to vocalize from a hollow full of trees that did not exceed 15 meters in height, located next to an unpaved road. Other owl (XC597616) was vocalizing on the other side of the road on a hill when this owl kept quiet. Throughout the bird watching travel, another 3 Megascops choliba vocalized, moving among the trees and interacting with each other. Same individual: XC597608

**Weather:** Clear sky, slightly cold.

**Recording distance:** 15 meters.

**Habitat:**  Mid andean forest.

**Equipment:**

**Recorder:** TASCAM DR-40

**Microphone:** Audio-Technica AT875R

**Accessories:** Rycote 15cm Classic-Softie windshield.

Copy (.wav) on Macaulay library: ML274188401
